title: Management system requirements
indexDescription: Each chapter explains one part of an Integrated Management System. Start with organisational context or find the topic you need.
publicNotice: This page introduces the management guide. Create an account or sign in to read each requirement and use its templates.
numbering: The numbering follows the chapters used in the standards. The materials cover requirements 4 to 7.
chapter4Description: Understand your organisation, interested parties, and management processes.
chapter5Description: Define commitments, responsibilities, and your management system policy.
chapter6Description: Identify risks and opportunities, and set objectives for improvement.
chapter7Description: Organise resources, skills, communication, and supporting documents.
audit: How does an auditor assess this requirement?
resourcesWhatText: The organisation must determine and provide the resources needed to establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve its Integrated Management System.
resourcesWhyText: Suitable resources help people carry out processes and help the organisation achieve its intended results.
resourcesExplanationText: Consider the organisation’s actual needs and the scope of its management system. Not every category below will be needed in every organisation.
resourcesPeople: People: availability and competence needed to perform activities.
resourcesInfrastructure: Infrastructure: facilities, equipment, IT systems, transport, and other supporting means.
resourcesEnvironment: Work environment: physical and human conditions needed for processes to work.
resourcesKnowledge: Organisational knowledge: internal and external knowledge needed to run processes and address change.
resourcesMaterials: Materials and services: raw materials, consumables, and external services that are needed.
resourcesFinancial: Financial resources: means to provide and maintain the resources that are needed.
resourcesActionText: Record the needs identified, who provides each resource, and how its suitability will be monitored. The standard does not require a specific template for this record.
